hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Eastern Asia, southern half of the Korean Peninsula bordering the Sea of Japan and the Yellow Sea || mostly hills and mountains; wide coastal plains in west and south || strategic location on Korea Strait; about 3,000 mostly small and uninhabited islands lie off the western and southern coasts || Resources: coal, tungsten, graphite, molybdenum, lead, hydropower potential || Exports: integrated circuits, cars, refined petroleum, plastics, machine parts (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly hills and mountains; wide coastal plains in west and south || Eastern Asia, southern half of the Korean Peninsula bordering the Sea of Japan and the Yellow Sea

climate.excerpt: temperate, with rainfall heavier in summer than winter; cold winters || occasional typhoons bring high winds and floods; low-level seismic activity common in southwest volcanism: Halla (1,950 m) is considered historically active; it has not erupted in many centuries

economy.excerpt: high-income, export- and technology-oriented East Asian economy; manufacturing led by semiconductor and automotive industries; slow growth amid declining construction investment, export risks, and recent political instability; aging workforce; increased restraint in fiscal policy while maintaining industry support initiatives || Exports: integrated circuits, cars, refined petroleum, plastics, machine parts (2023) || Industries: electronics, telecommunications, automobile production, chemicals, shipbuilding, steel
